text:
Priya: Heads-up: Prospect trial (NorthStar) ran a scripted workload and started hitting 5xxs ~15:24PT. Sales escalated; CISO asked for RCA + whether "no 5xx" is possible for the demo.

Kofi: What model and sample ids?

Priya: Model r-instruct-large-v1. Sample req ids: 9f1a2b3c, c4d5e6f7. Errors are 502/503, occasional 504. Traffic was bursty: ~280-330 rps for ~2m bursts.

Elaine: Pulling traces now. Pattern: frontdoor queue spikes, worker grpc UNAVAILABLE (14) when backlog crosses ~120 requests -> frontdoor surfaces 502. New pods show model-init 17-20s (quant JIT); no OOMs.

Marco: Quick mitigation options: (A) tenant warm instance (1 GPU prewarmed), (B) tenant fallback to r-instruct-medium-quant when queue_threshold crossed, (C) reduce tenant max_batch to 1, (D) switch eval-pool autoscaler to queue-based with lower cooldown. We should pick 2 combined.

Priya: Sales wants the cheapest combination that makes the demo reliable. CISO wants a diagnostic bundle and confirmation that prompts are not retained longer than our default.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: scale request triggered for northstar-pool at 15:25:12; +3 nodes requested.

Elaine: I uploaded diagnostics: https://redwood-internal/diag/2712345678 - contains frontdoor traces, worker logs, model load times, autoscale events. Default retention 30d; prompts are redacted in audit bundles unless tenant enables verbose logging. Security@redwood.ai can extend retention on request.

Kofi: For the demo, I'd recommend B + C first (fallback + max_batch=1) as immediate low-cost changes, then A (warm instance) for the live window if sales wants extra safety.

Priya: Agreed. Marco, can you apply fallback and batch change? Also Sales wants a cost quote for a 3-hour warm prewarm.

Marco: Applying now.

deploy-bot: apply: tenant(northstar).fallback=r-instruct-medium-quant -> accepted
deploy-bot: apply: tenant(northstar).max_batch=1 -> accepted

Marco: Drafting cost note: prewarm hourly ~= $0.60/hr (eval GPU). 3h -> ~$1.80. If they want SLA-level guarantees we should propose Dedicated (formal SLA + warm pools) with sales/legal.

Priya: Can we also flip the scale policy to queue-based for this pool for the next 8h? That helps earlier scaling on backlog.

deploy-bot: apply: northstar-pool.scale_policy=queue_based cooldown=30s duration=8h -> accepted

Kofi: Client-side recommendation: add simple retry with jitter and small backoff. Snippet to send to customer team: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
{
  "model": "r-instruct-large-v1",
  "max_tokens": 128,
  "batch_size": 1
}
```
Retry: 2 attempts, base=100ms, jitter, max=800ms.

Priya: Sales asked if we can "guarantee no 5xxs" for a 1-hour demo. What's our official stance?

security-bot: Note: We cannot promise zero 5xxs on hosted trial infrastructure. Offer Dedicated deployment for contractual SLAs. For demos we provide operational mitigations and a practice run.

sales-bot: Customer pushing for a guarantee. They say it's a compliance demo for auditors.

Priya: Response draft for sales: "We cannot guarantee zero 5xxs on hosted trials. For audit-grade guarantees we recommend Dedicated with SLA and warm pools. For the demo we will enable fallback, set max_batch=1, flip to queue-based autoscaling, and provision a 1-GPU warm instance for the demo window (3h) — estimated cost $1.80. We also recommend a 2-min practice run at demo start. Diagnostics bundle link and redaction policy provided to CISO."

Marco: After changes, monitoring shows queue depth peaked at 118 then started draining; 5xx rate fell from ~11% -> 0.8% over 6 minutes. Keeping an eye.

Elaine: Note: the main root cause is cold-start latency from quant kernel JIT on new pods under spike. Long-term fix: prewarm kernels or persist a warm kernel cache for common models. I'll add an action item to eng-runtime backlog.

Kofi: Sales: are you comfortable offering the 3h warm prewarm? They accepted the $1.80 estimate in the thread and want the official approval.

Priya: Approve the 3h warm prewarm for this trial as a one-off. Ops, keep configs and revert after 8h unless sales requests extension. Also attach the diag link in the sales ticket and copy security@redwood.ai for retention questions.

deploy-bot: prewarm: provisioning 1-gpu for tenant northstar duration=3h -> accepted

sales-bot: Client scheduled a practice run at demo time. They asked for the diag link and the retry snippet.

Elaine: Final note: we'll monitor for next 30m and post another health update. Current 5xx is 0.6% over 5m.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll send sales the finalized note and close the loop once demo is complete.
